sampling_rule: Nearest N eligible cells to the arithmetic mean of all eligible cervical centroids; squared Euclidean distance, original cell order breaks ties; no random sampling.
stage_policy: Prepare nested central 200k and 400k; run SpatialESS at both sizes first, then attempt SpatialCellChat at each size independently under the same 96 GiB address-space budget. Preserve all failures, and compare only completed pairs. This is an explicitly requested extension beyond the previous per-tissue stopping boundary.
memory_budget_definition: 96 GiB virtual address space per worker, not a 96 GiB RSS cap
figure_policy: The delivered Figure 1 is a pre-run snapshot: cervical 200k and 400k remain not attempted until real results are reviewed. Queue progress is saved separately.
